description: Weighted audit rules for roadmap contract quality scoring. Each rule is evaluated against a parsed roadmap contract and contributes to a 0–100 maturity score.

rules.name: roadmap-file-present
rules.description: A ROADMAP.md (or equivalent) file exists in the repository root.
rules.message: No ROADMAP.md file found. The repository has no roadmap at all.
rules.recommendedAction: Create a ROADMAP.md using the canonical template at standards/roadmap/ROADMAP_TEMPLATE.md.

rules.name: roadmap-parseable
rules.description: The roadmap file can be parsed without errors (contains at least one checkbox item).
rules.message: Roadmap file exists but could not be parsed. No checkbox items were found.
rules.recommendedAction: Add at least one release section with checklist items using '- [ ] task' and '- [x] done' syntax.

rules.name: roadmap-has-pending-work
rules.description: The roadmap contains at least one unchecked item, indicating active work.
rules.message: All roadmap items are marked complete. No pending work is visible.
rules.recommendedAction: Add a new release section with future milestones, or archive this roadmap and create a new one.

rules.name: has-product-intent-section
rules.description: The roadmap includes a product intent or scope section that describes what the product does and who it serves.
rules.message: No product intent or scope section detected.
rules.recommendedAction: Add a 'Product Intent' section near the top of ROADMAP.md describing what the product does, who it serves, and the problem it solves.

rules.name: uses-release-sections
rules.description: Work is organized into release-scoped sections (e.g. '## Release X.Y — Title') rather than a single flat list.
rules.message: Roadmap does not use release-scoped sections. Work items appear in a flat or informal structure.
rules.recommendedAction: Reorganize the roadmap into bounded release sections. Each release should have a heading, goal statement, and checklist.

rules.name: has-acceptance-criteria
rules.description: At least one release section includes acceptance criteria defining when the release can be declared done.
rules.message: No acceptance criteria found in any release section.
rules.recommendedAction: Add an 'Acceptance criteria' subsection to each release with observable conditions for completion.

rules.name: has-out-of-scope-boundaries
rules.description: At least one release section explicitly defines what is out of scope.
rules.message: No out-of-scope boundaries found in any release section.
rules.recommendedAction: Add an 'Out of scope' subsection to each release to prevent scope creep and reduce ambiguity for coding agents.

rules.name: sufficient-pending-item-count
rules.description: The roadmap contains enough pending items to justify Copilot dispatch (minimum 3 unchecked items).
rules.message: Fewer than 3 pending roadmap items. The roadmap may not provide sufficient context for reliable dispatch.
rules.recommendedAction: Add more concrete, testable milestones to give Copilot enough bounded work to deliver.

rules.name: has-multiple-releases
rules.description: The roadmap defines more than one release, showing a multi-step plan rather than a single sprint.
rules.message: Only one release section found. A multi-release roadmap provides better forward visibility.
rules.recommendedAction: Add a second release section for the next planned increment of work.

rules.name: no-vague-checklist-items
rules.description: Checklist items are concrete and testable, not vague placeholders.
rules.message: One or more checklist items appear to be vague placeholders.
rules.recommendedAction: Replace vague items with concrete, testable, implementation-specific steps.

L1-Informal.description: Roadmap exists but is a flat list, lacks structure, or has parse errors.

L2-Structured.description: Roadmap has checkboxes and some organization, but lacks release sections or acceptance criteria.

L3-Contract-Ready.description: Roadmap uses release sections, has acceptance criteria, and is parseable. Ready for supervised dispatch.

L4-Orchestration-Ready.description: Roadmap passes all critical and warning rules. Suitable for autonomous or semi-autonomous Copilot orchestration.
